as_told.title: Carlos sees recording of his own regression session

plain: Carlos de Souza is a Brazilian man who says he saw a strange craft come down near the town of Varginha, Brazil, in 1996, and later came face to face with a creature there. Years afterwards, around 2022, he says he went through hypnotic regression, a method where a hypnotist guides a person back to memories they may have buried, during a session at a beach. Speaking on the podcast of host Jesse Michels, he reports what he says is on the video recording of that session. According to the recording, he was desperate to get closer to the creature, and it spoke to him in his mind: "Calm down. Everything is fine. Go away. It's dangerous for you here." He also points to a source he calls Saga. If true, it would mean a being from the crash could talk to people by thought. In a second telling on the same show, Carlos says only that he believes it because he saw the tape himself, and he does not repeat what the creature said.
